children: RNS Number : 6218U  Oryx International Growth Fund Ld  14 September 2026

The Board of Oryx is pleased to note the proposed acquisition of Tribal Group Plc. Based on the expected sale proceeds of 86p per share, this will increase the most recent Net Asset Value of Oryx by approximately 44p per share.
